title: How to Create a Schematic with Litematica
summary: How to create and save a .litematica schematic of your build using Litematica and MaLiLib.

items: Litematica and MaLiLib installed for your Minecraft version
A world containing the build you'd like to save
Open your world with Minecraft, Litematica, and MaLiLib loaded.
Equip the Litematica tool. By default, this is a stick.
Switch to Area Selection mode by holding Ctrl and scrolling your mouse wheel until 'Area Selection' is active.
Select your build. Left-click one corner of the structure, then right-click the opposite diagonal corner to create a selection box. Use Alt + Scroll to adjust the edges of your selection.
Open the Litematica menu by pressing M.
In the Area Selection Browser, find your active selection and click Save Schematic.
Give your schematic a name and confirm. The .litematica file will be saved to your schematics folder.

body.text: Your schematics will be saved to the `schematics/` folder in your Minecraft instance directory:

items: Windows: `%APPDATA%\.minecraft\schematics\` (or your custom launcher instance folder)
